name: @cesium-ai/codegen-sandbox
description: Browser-executed QuickJS-wasm sandbox that runs already-verified CesiumJS code directly against a live Viewer's real API surface, plus client-side execution guardrails (entity/collection caps). The execution half of the Code Mode pipeline that @cesium-ai/codegen-cesium generates and statically verifies; frontend-only (depends on cesium + quickjs-emscripten), never imported server-side.

scripts.build: npm run validate:cesium-compat && npm run generate:value-type-registry && npm run generate:cesium-bundle && tsc
